cards.heading: Innovation & Energy Efficiency
cards.text: From our founding in 1968 to today’s net-zero commitments, each milestone tells a story of progress — not only in computing power, but in building a greener, more responsible future.

cards.heading: Climate Action & Net-Zero Goals
cards.text: Collaboration with partners, governments, and communities has been key to accelerating sustainable innovation worldwide.

cards.heading: Circularity & Stewardship
cards.text: Our focus on energy efficiency, water stewardship, and circularity drives measurable impact across our fabs, supply chain, and products—turning long-term goals into tangible results.
